source.title: MBS Statistical Yearbook 2024, Table 11.6: Selected Vehicles According to Registration, 2018 end

scope.official_observation: Vehicle counts are officially published only for Male, Hulhumale, Addu and Other atolls.
scope.island_table: Male and Hulhumale retain official locality counts. Addu and Other atolls are allocated across inhabited islands for planning use only.
scope.not_claimed: The estimated island rows are not an island-level vehicle registry and must not be described as observed registration records.
scope.zero_population_islands: Excluded from the allocation because the population-proportional method has no defensible denominator; resort, industrial and uninhabited island registrations remain unknown.
